text:
Sarah (AE): Heads up — Zephyr POC: customer says TTFT ~2.2–2.8s vs expected 700ms. They also pinged on pricing + security Qs. Can we swarm? :eyes:
Marie (SE): On it. Any sample request + model + endpoint? Also do they have VPC/private deployment? That can affect routing.
Sarah (AE): Using hosted endpoint r-inference-prod, model 'rwd-13b-quant'. Sample request attached (short chat). Also they are testing from EU region but account is on us-west; they mention occasional 429s too.
Jon Eng: 2.2s TTFT suggests cache warmup misses. Check token warmup + KV cache hit rate. Can you paste a sample request id or request body?
Sarah (AE): request_id: abc123-zeph, payload:
```json
{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q3 results"}],"max_tokens":256}
```
Marie (SE): Thanks. From logs, see a lot of cold starts: routing spread across 4 replicas — prefix caching is per-replica so high miss rate if traffic isn't sticky.
Alex (Infra): We saw routing policy set to 'round_robin' for that customer to distribute burst. Change to 'session_affinity' to improve KV cache reuse. I'll patch the route now.
ops-bot: Deploy start r-inference-prod route update by alex_infra at 2024-10-12T14:02:12Z
Marie (SE): Also disable aggressive batching for low concurrent single-user tests; current batching window 50ms is aggregating variable-length requests causing longer TTFT. Recommend 10ms for POC.
Jon Eng: Reproduced locally: with session_affinity + 10ms batching TTFT goes to ~650ms median. Without affinity it's ~2.1s. Logs snippet:
```
[2024-10-12 14:05:30] request abc123-zeph route=replica-03 cache_hit=false batch_wait=48ms kernel=fp16
[2024-10-12 14:05:30] request abc124 route=replica-03 cache_hit=true batch_wait=12ms
```
Sarah (AE): Nice. Customer also asked about pricing for sustained 100 rps. Any docs? :moneybag:
Marie (SE): Send the dedicated pricing sheet and mention autoscaling savings. I'll include notes about cache-friendly workloads lowering unit tokens cost.
Jon Eng: Final note — there is a small bug where health-checks from our LB were setting a unique header that bypasses cache keys; I've opened infra ticket INF-789 to fix header normalization.
Sarah (AE): Great — next steps: Alex flips affinity (done), Marie adjusts batching (done), Jon files INF-789, Sarah to send pricing + security contacts. I'll loop in the customer. Thanks team :raised_hands:
ACME POC (customer): Confirmed — after changes TTFT down to ~720ms, 429s gone. We'll run security questionnaire next week.
